games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

games.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches Soundtrack
100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color
Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced - Additional mode "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX"
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary:
War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4. A young squad of South Korean soldiers fight to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control. Modern Warfare® 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.

- Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory.
- Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement.
- In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every extraction run into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.

games.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
games.summary: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person mafia-themed fighting game where you must assemble your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

games.name: Courier of the Dead
games.summary:
Courier of the Dead is an atmospheric horror experience set in an abandoned village where the the dead are disturbed after sunset.

Each night, the courier must deliver letters meant for restless spirits scattered throughout the village. The messages left behind contain clues about where their recipients lie, forcing players to read carefully and navigate the dark streets to discover the correct resting places.

To survive the night, players must interpret clues to locate delivery items, as well as collectible items, and complete deliveries before the night ends.

games.name: DEAD TIME
games.summary: Nobody can see the timers. 2–8 players strapped to their chairs at a sinister game-show table, shock collars on: estimate time blind, bluff, call people out. Miss the time and the collar answers; get doubted and the doubter pulls the trigger. Local, online or solo vs. bots.

games.name: Dealer's Choice
games.summary: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.

games.name: Deeper Than Gold
games.summary: Descend into an endless crypt alone or with up to three friends. Fight goblin hordes across five biomes and their bosses, stack relics and blessings, and decide when to turn back – gold only counts once you get it out alive. How deep will you go?

games.name: Empty The Lake!
games.summary: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

games.name: Eric's Farm
games.summary: Feed 'em... or get BONKED! Keep Eric's demanding chickens, goats and alpacas happy in a slapstick 3D farm game. Throw ridiculous snacks, dodge hangry attacks, smash the scenery and survive ten chaotic days, with boss fights, five minigames and endless mode.

games.name: Evercursed: Act I
games.summary: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Fruitpocalypse
games.summary: The veggies have risen. Only the fruits stand in their way. Survive 20 waves of evil vegetables, twisted bosses and cursed nights in this cartoon arena roguelite.

games.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

games.name: Glowtide Isle
games.summary: Start a new life as a cat on a small, sleepy island. Fish, catch bugs, dig up fossils and decorate your home, then shape cliffs, rivers and paths your way. Befriend 24 animal neighbors, fill the museum and relight the old Tide Whistle, one cozy day at a time.

games.name: Gross Survivors
games.summary: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

games.name: Halls of Torment - The Lost Archives
Hell's Handbook

games.name: High Stakes Chess
games.summary: A fusion of poker and chess where cards determine the pieces you bring into battle. Bet on each hand, place your pieces, then fight it out on the chessboard.

Infinitynoid
games.summary: Break an infinite field of bricks in every direction. Every ring is a new level, every level unlocks a new chiptune track, and the shop turns one lonely ball into a storm of exploding, block-shredding chaos. Then zoom out. Forever.

games.name: Jewelmix
games.summary: The classics reimagined! Rearrange and stack falling multicolored columns to align three matching jewels. Test your speed and reflexes to beat the high score and unlock all 60 achievements!

games.name: Last Light: Chalk Creek
games.summary: Three strangers are stranded in a rural town overrun by the infected and things that crawl out of the ground. Fight through an illustrated three-chapter story or hold out for three days in an isometric shooter with nine weapons, destructible scenery, dynamic weather and a day–night cycle.

games.name: Little Spring
games.summary: Compress. Aim. Release. Guide a little spring through the pages of an old patent. Judge slopes, ride moving platforms and set curious mechanisms in motion across 20 handcrafted physics challenges. Unlock six springs, each with a character of its own.

games.name: Lumbrix
games.summary: Lumbrix is a survivors-like shooter where every segment of your growing worm is both a weapon and a life. Aim your head cannon, shield yourself with your body, evolve your weapons and survive ten minutes to face the boss.

games.name: Moadra
games.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: Mojo Is Loved
games.summary: Mojo invites his ex and an old friend to hear his new EP. Their kindness is real... until the room starts rewriting every sign of rejection. A short psychological horror visual novel about love, reassurance, and the cost of demanding certainty.

games.name: MoonTraum
games.summary: *MoonTraum* is a fishing game set in a mysterious dream world. Lost in a world where dreams take the form of fish, you meet Welt, a cat fisherman, and begin your fishing adventure. Catch uniquely designed fish and complete your collection!

games.name: No One Left To Die Demo
ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Orbital Madness
games.summary: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

games.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror film with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

games.name: Pactmage - Chess Roster
games.summary: Pactmage: Chess Roster is a turn-based tactics game where every character has skills and an element. Win in Adventure Mode and form a Pact to recruit them — all 60+ units are free. Play the story mode, fight a friend locally, or battle online in PvP. No gacha, no paid units.

games.name: PALJA Survivors
games.summary: A survival roguelike where your birth date determines your Saju character. Dodge swarming foes, choose upgrades and items, and face five years of yearly battles and Guardians shaped by your fortune. Even with the same Saju, your choices lead to a different journey.

games.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Judge Dredd™
Police Activity: Cardboardman
games.summary: Police Activity: Cardboardman is a first-person slasher game where, in one segment, you play as a serial killer nicknamed "Cardboardman," and in the other, as a detective trying to catch him.

games.name: Princess Ilyana: Night of Falling Grace
Rally: Village Defense
games.summary: A cozy yet brainy Backpack-like Roguelike bullet heaven village defense. Recruit villager heroes, manage grid slots, merge orange Super Heroes, and stop the demolition crew! 50 chapters, 12 heroes, 11 Super Heroes.

games.name: Remain Seated
games.summary: you've fallen into an abandoned hospital and have become wheelchair-bound. With limited mobility You must use your resources to find yourself a way out while avoiding any dangers that may lurk within.

games.name: Renz Soccer Sim
games.summary: Build your squad, develop players, manage your club, and watch every match unfold in this 2D soccer management simulator. Chase trophies and build a dynasty.

games.name: RETURN TO 1990
games.summary: Reborn in 1990 Seoul with memories of 2027. Rewrite twenty years through stocks, real estate and startups in this Korean-language business-sim visual novel. (Korean only)

games.name: Reverie: Audio Stories
games.summary: Illustrated audio stories where you decide what happens next. Listen on headphones or speakers, choose left or right, and enjoy them even with your eyes closed. First story free: The Messenger of Corbeval, 40 minutes and 7 endings.

games.name: Rouge and Run
games.summary: Dive into the cursed world of Rouge and Run. Customize your loadout, strategies, and plan your time management wisely to escape The Fog of Rouge from consuming you.

games.name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
games.summary: Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

games.name: Sakura Hime 7
games.summary: In a paradise of blooming cherry blossoms, catgirls, witches, and elves gather around you. Share sweet everyday moments with them and build a lavish harem all your own.

games.name: Sawad
games.summary: In SAWAD, you and your friends are content creators desperate for FAME and subscribers. Break into haunted locations, eliminate whatever is there. Hidden CCTVs record it all. Make the clips go viral and get filthy rich! The only catch? You must survive long enough to hit upload.

games.name: Second Source
games.summary: Every report on your desk is intelligence or bait. Four artifacts — agency, timestamp, position, text — and a planted one contradicts itself in exactly one. Call it before the clock does, hold the line as DEFCON drops, and when they breach the building, run the extraction on foot.

games.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
games.summary: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

games.name: Soul (Stavros Aeneas Kokkineas)
games.summary: Lyr is a city where Souls are a product. Big corporations can change your soul for the right price. Smaller merchants can give you relief for an afternoon. This is a Visual Novel with some minor choices that change the dialogue a little. You progress through the story by clicking on the screen.

games.name: Super Clown Save Santa
games.summary: 2.5d Platformer where you control Super Clown. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and enemy bee and Save Santa Claus and Save Christmas

games.name: Suspencil
games.summary: An online drawing and social deduction game for up to 8 players. Draw your prompt and discuss the drawings to find the Werewolf—the only one with a different prompt. The Madman scribbles on others’ drawings to help the Werewolf. Even if caught, the Werewolf can win by guessing the Citizens’ prompt.

games.name: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection
games.summary: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection is a relaxing fantasy card-collecting game. Explore the room, discover thousands of cards, examine rare finds, and carefully organize your collection in cabinets by faction and rarity.

games.name: Terra Machina
games.summary: Dig deep, build big, and let science do the smashing! TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox. Turn mountains of ore into powerful drills, weapons, and automated factories across diverse biomes. Play solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
games.summary: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

games.name: The Grave Abyss
games.summary: Grab your sword and descend to the deepest depths of a corrupted cave to find and destroy the source of evil that plagues the small town of Oakhaven. The Grave Abyss is an old school single player, 3d dungeon crawler RPG with turn based combat.

games.name: The Guest from the Fields
games.summary: Do you know all the flags of the world?in the flag quiz you will find all the flags of the world, at any flag you need to guess the country.If you ever get stuck just take one of the tips.

games.name: The Wizard is SUS
games.summary: A WIZARD YEETED A GIANT MAGIC DOME ONTO AN ENTIRE TOWN AND THEN DISAPPEARED. Now you have to bonk skeletons, fold zombies, collect suspicious runes, and break into his tower to figure out what went wrong.

games.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
games.summary: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

games.name: THERMAL RUNAWAY (Alexframe)
games.summary: Fool Quiz is a  puzzle,entitlement game, whether children or adult can play. Game used life,  mathematical knowledge, test your  reactions and memory and so on, come on, give it a try.

games.name: Tidy Tails
games.summary: Your cat has turned the shop upside down, and 5,555 cat plushies are waiting to go back on their shelves. Upgrade your skills and your cat's, change the weather to transform the gameplay, play minigames and hunt for collectibles while you wonder what the garage hides once everything is tidy.

games.name: Touwers: Defend the Realm
games.summary: Touwers is a fantasy tower defense strategy game where you place towers on a grid, hold the line through escalating enemy waves, and grow your economy to be able to unlock all kinds of perks along your way through 4 distinct campaigns.

games.name: Trivia Mania
games.summary: Welcome to Trivia Mania! Test your knowledge about the most common trivia questions, and improve your own performance. Trivia Mania has over 4,700 questions across eight genres. Game modes such as the Gauntlet, Ladder, Survival and Custom allow you to play in different fun and interactive ways.

games.name: UNCOUNTED
games.summary: Uncounted is a massive incremental tower defense. One sector, one wave: tens of thousands of hostiles simulated on the GPU. Place and aim every turret before the drop, then spend the run to unlock the next gun.

games.name: Victoria 3: State and Revolution
games.summary: BIN90 HD will let you have a wonderful time, while challenging your attention and luck. If you have never won a lottery in real life, why not give it a try and become a champion online? Each player will receive 3 cards with a 9x3 table on each and numbers ranging from 1 through 90 randomly placed in each cell (5 in each row). This is when the fun begins – the program takes barrels with random numbers out of a virtual bag. As the bag empties, the cells on the players’ cards fill in. In each round of BIN90 HD there are several winners – the bronze medal (and 15% of the jackpot) goes to the player who first fills one row on any card, the silver medal and 25% of the jackpot go to the player who fills 2 rows, and the honorary first place and half the jackpot go to the player who fills all the rows on any card. In addition, there are bonuses which make it easier to fill out the game cards: · automatic filling of the next barrel; ·  automatic display of the next five barrels; ·  filling-in of the missed barrel (after it disappears from the top panel); ·  convenient cell lighting corresponding to the barrel pulled. See you at the game table!

games.name: Who Invited You?
games.summary: One of your guests isn't a guest. Serve drinks, fix burst pipes, and keep the party alive while a copycat quietly replaces someone you know. Co-op social deduction for 1-4 players.

games.name: Zombie Last Stand
games.summary: Take your last stand against an evolving zombie swarm. Fight ten enemy types and two deadly bosses, collect special bullets, armor and permanent upgrades, survive extreme weather events, unlock SWAT skins, complete achievements, and chase a higher score with every run.

A Cruise for Murder
games.summary: A 3D modern remake of the classic Cruise for a Corpse, along with original music, different plot and 15 puzzles.

games.name: Biden Blast
games.summary: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

games.name: Dungeon Inn
games.summary:
As Sara, the ambitious innkeeper, you’ve struck a deal with a dragon to open an inn right next to a mysterious dungeon that appeared near the dragon's lair. With adventurers from rival guilds eager to explore the dungeon’s secrets, your inn has become the perfect pit stop for them.

Your challenge? Keep these competing groups from crossing paths while maximizing profits. It’s a delicate balancing act, but who cares if they’re rivals? As long as we don’t get caught, everyone’s happy - especially your coin purse!

Welcome to the art of dungeon-adjacent hospitality, where discretion meets ambition, and every guest is a potential goldmine. Let the games begin!

games.name: Eggsecution Squad
games.summary: Eggsecution Squad is a fast, chaotic egg brawler for up to 4 players — local or online. Grab 14+ wild weapons, dash, block and punch across 5 maps, and knock the other eggs off or kill them. Last egg standing wins. Dress your egg up and beat up your friends (in game).

Gold Admiral
games.summary: Explore, trade, research, and fight across a turn-based naval strategy sandbox. Found coastal cities, command fleets and armies, clear pirate hideouts and dungeons, and shape each campaign through economy, diplomacy, or conquest.

games.name: Hivemind
games.summary: Hivemind is a free online party game where players give clues, guess hidden targets on fun spectrums, and score points by thinking alike. Perfect for game nights, remote hangouts, icebreakers, and quick laughs with friends.

games.name: Last House Standing
games.summary: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

games.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
games.summary: Fight through zombie hordes in a single-player top-down 3D shooter. Rescue survivors, destroy infected facilities and escape across seven maps. Upgrade guns, unlock four characters and bring a tank, collie or robot dog to support your next operation.

games.name: Sad Damn
games.summary: Sad Damn is hiding. Use your fortress to blast your way to him. Tear through his generals' defenses, get better weapons, and try not to get blown up first.

games.name: SHAME
games.summary: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

games.name: Unicorn Dash 1
games.summary: Race, battle, explore, collect, and craft across an evolving multiplayer unicorn universe from the streets of Paris and London to mystical worlds, Mars, and outer space.

games.name: Void Squadron
games.summary: Fight, mine, and build your squadron in a 3D space-combat roguelike. Turn asteroid ore into upgrades, weapons, and AI wingmates. Recruit miners, protectors, and attack ships, tear down pirate bases, destroy alien motherships, and push your build through escalating waves.

games.name: Want a Bomb?
games.summary: Blow up mountains with your friends in this chaotic online co-op game. Collect minerals, buy bigger explosives, build chains of explosions, and experiment with bomb-loaded drones, explosive baseballs, and a launcher that can send your friends flying.

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
